methodology: bulk grep + awk extraction + python DFS cycle detection on /tmp/service_deps.txt. Constructor injection parsed from `function __construct(...)` block. No file modified.
cyclic_dependencies_note: DFS run on adjacency graph of 13 service-to-service injection edges across 27 nodes. ZERO cycles detected. Laravel container would refuse to boot on circular constructor injection, so absence is structurally expected — confirmed empirically here.

facade_usage_count.interpretation: Auth:: appears 109× inside services — services should not query the auth subject; this couples business logic to request context. DB:: in services (214 hits) usually means raw transactions or query-builder bypass — acceptable for Fiscal/Pricing but a smell elsewhere. Log:: high count (435 svc + 46 ctrl) is healthy observability.

form_requests_drift_note: VERIFIED count = 66 — matches BRAIN §9 'observed today' but baseline sentinel still set to 69 (count<baseline passes, so CI green). 29 FormRequests authorize() did NOT match `return true;` window (they either delegate to permission/can() or have empty/missing authorize). Ratchet opportunity: lower RETURN_TRUE_BASELINE constant to 66 to tighten ceiling.

absent: Order (OrderService 2837 LOC + FrontendOrderService 1391 LOC use Eloquent direct)
Fiscal (FiscalSequenceService + ZReportService + AuditLogService all touch models)
repository_layer_presence.interpretation: 18 of 19 service subdomains lack a repository layer. Services-to-models-direct count = 173 grep hits across app/Services/. This is the FoodKing architectural reality: Service IS the data access boundary; Eloquent IS the ORM. No abstraction. Repository pattern was never adopted except for idempotency keys (which need swappable DB/Redis backends). Honest verdict: documenting this as the chosen pattern is fine; converting to repositories is V2 SaaS-prep, not V1 production work.

god_services_note: Schema reserves slots only for controllers; surfaced here as adversarial-grade because OrderService at 2837 LOC is the single largest architectural risk in the codebase. Frozen-zone constraint blocks decomposition of PricingService + ZReportService without LOCK; the V1.0.2 backlog is the right venue for OrderService split planning.

adversarial_findings.claim: OrderService.php at 2837 LOC = single largest god-service in codebase, 5.7× the 500-LOC threshold. Touches Order creation, mutation, status transitions, fiscal allocation, refunds. Schema gives no slot — surfaced here.
adversarial_findings.remediation: V1.0.2 backlog: extract OrderCreationService + OrderMutationService + OrderStateTransitionService along OrderStateMachine boundary (BRAIN §7 freeze applies only to OrderStateMachine.php, not OrderService.php).

adversarial_findings.claim: Controller bypass smell: 27% of controllers (38/141) call Eloquent models directly, bypassing the service layer. Worst offenders LoyaltyController (14 hits), StockRuptureDashboardController (15 hits). Loyalty has User::where('loyalty_code',...) which means LoyaltyService doesn't own loyalty-code resolution.
adversarial_findings.remediation: Refactor LoyaltyController.lookup() → LoyaltyService::resolveByCode(). StockRuptureDashboardController is a read-only dashboard — direct query acceptable IF service-level alternative is over-engineering. Owner judgement call.

adversarial_findings.claim: Auth:: facade used 109× inside services. Services should be context-free; auth subject should be passed in, not queried via facade. Couples business logic to HTTP request context, breaks queue/CLI invocations.
adversarial_findings.remediation: Pass User|null explicitly into service methods. V1.0.2 chip-away.

adversarial_findings.claim: Repository layer effectively absent (2 files, both Idempotency). 18 of 19 service subdomains query models directly. Service IS the persistence boundary in FoodKing — this is a design choice, not a bug, but should be documented in ARCHITECTURE.md so newcomers don't propose unnecessary repository introductions.
adversarial_findings.remediation: Documentation update, not code change. NOT a V1 ship blocker.

adversarial_findings.claim: Zero cyclic dependencies in service constructor injection across 27 nodes / 13 edges. Confirms healthy DI hygiene. No remediation.

Zero controllers exceed the 20-method threshold for split candidates. The 10-method ceiling reached by LoyaltyController + DashboardController is the practical max. Top method count = 15 (DashboardController).
No controller injects 10+ services — max dep count observed = 2. Orchestration smell ABSENT. Constructors are lean across the board.

No private mutable service state detected via grep heuristic — no obvious singleton-in-queue risk found in services. Caveat: heuristic is shallow; deeper review would inspect setters and trait-based state.
adversarial_findings.remediation: none for V1; deeper review V1.0.2 if queue workloads grow.

adversarial_findings.claim: FormRequest return-true sentinel baseline (69) is now 3 above actual count (66). Lowering RETURN_TRUE_BASELINE to 66 ratchets the ceiling tighter and surfaces any regression immediately.

verdict_rubric: GREEN if no cycles AND no controller god-class >800 LOC AND FormRequest count stable. AMBER if cycles==0 but service god-class >2× threshold OR controller bypass smell >25%. RED if cycles>0 OR FormRequest count drifted UP from sentinel.
verdict_justification: GREEN signals: zero cycles, zero controllers >20 methods, no controller orchestration smell (>=10 deps), FormRequest count drifted DOWN (66<69 baseline=safer). AMBER signals: OrderService.php at 2837 LOC is a real architectural risk, controller→model bypass at 27% (LoyaltyController 14 direct hits, StockRupture 15) means LoyaltyService/StockService don't fully own their domain. Frozen-zone constraint blocks immediate fix on Pricing/Fiscal god-services. NO V1 SHIP BLOCKER — all findings are V1.0.2 backlog. Verdict AMBER = ship V1 as-is, schedule chip-away in V1.0.2 wave.
